description: This PHP source file defines the SaveQualificationEducationController class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. The class manages rendering components related to qualification education, specifically for editing or saving qualifications, based on request parameters.

classes.name: SaveQualificationEducationController
classes.description: Controller responsible for rendering qualification education forms, either for editing an existing qualification or saving a new one, depending on request data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component to be rendered, selecting between 'qualification-education-edit' and 'qualification-education-save' based on whether an 'id' attribute is present in the request.
